zh: The Aviation Herald 報導六起民航安全事件
en: The Aviation Herald reports six civil aviation safety incidents.

zh: 奧克蘭撤銷對西南航空訴訟後 航班與座位數減少13.5%
en: Oakland sees 13.5% flight schedule and seat reduction after Southwest lawsuit dismissal

zh: 美國航空波音737-800於芝加哥奧黑爾降落滑行時爆胎
en: American Airlines Boeing 737-800 suffers tire burst while taxiing at Chicago O'Hare

zh: FAA指令要求航機後推後頭等艙禁止飲用飲料
en: FAA order bans first class beverages after pushback

zh: FAA關注逾470架波音737 MAX機身完整性，數百架客機須受特定檢查
en: FAA raises concerns over 470 Boeing 737 MAX fuselages, requiring future inspections

zh: 塞斯納441包機於阿拉斯加雷達站附近墜毀，機上8人全數罹難。
en: Eight killed in Cessna 441 crash near remote Alaska radar site.

zh: 聯合航空與勞斯萊斯發生爭執 45架A350引進添變數
en: United Airlines dispute with Rolls-Royce puts 45 Airbus A350s at risk

zh: 美籍國航機師合約範疇條款限制區域客機76座與重量門檻
en: US pilot scope clauses cap regional partner aircraft at 76 seats and 86,000 pounds MTOW

zh: 台灣虎航將於9月1日起調漲訂位服務費
en: Tigerair Taiwan to adjust booking service fees from September 1

zh: 中共18機艦船在台海周邊活動，國軍運用機艦與飛彈系統監控應處。
en: Taiwan tracked 18 Chinese military aircraft and vessels operating around the Taiwan Strait.
